purpose: 生成：不侵占游戏主体的轻柔绵延细雨循环环境音
arguments: A seamless loop of very light, gentle drizzle in the open air, heard from a distance. A soft continuous wash of tiny raindrops, even and calm, with subdued high frequencies and almost no individual drops standing out. An unobtrusive background ambience beneath game music and footsteps. No close-up dripping, sharp splashes, heavy rain, thunder, wind, voices or music.
